blocks.text: 12 Maple Ridge neighbourhood guides, from the Town Centre to Whonnock

parts.t: Each Maple Ridge area on my site has its own guide covering schools, parks and planning, plus flood notes and the things to check before buying. Every fact has a source next to it.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. Updated October 17, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate since 2015.
Whenever a card names a bus route, its guide notes the date of the timetable I consulted from TransLink, so check the current schedule.
The MLS® sub-areas covered by these guides have no boundary published by the City of Maple Ridge, so the guides follow sub-area names instead of City boundaries.

Questions about a Maple Ridge area? Call or text
Which Maple Ridge areas have a guide?
Do these areas have official boundaries?

The names are MLS® sub-areas, which the City of Maple Ridge does not publish as boundaries. Albion, the Town Centre, Hammond and Silver Valley each have a City area plan, and each guide says how it places its area and gives facts by address.
Which guide covers the Town Centre?
The City’s Town Centre Area Plan covers the downtown core, and I use it in both my
guides. If your address is near the line between them, read both.
How do I check the school for an address?
Maple Ridge’s public schools are run by School District 42 (SD42). Catchments are set by address, so confirm an exact address with
. Each guide lists the schools the Province’s school list shows for its area.
Do the guides have flood and slope notes?

Yes. Each guide has a flood section with notes from City pages, and the Southwest guide also covers the City’s rule on groundwater and drainage inside the Fraser River escarpment area. Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
. Each guide says what I found for its area.
